properties.name: reactor.dubbo.enabled
properties.description: Enables the generated Rust-backed Dubbo consumer and provider runtime.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.profile
properties.description: Applies the micro, balanced, or throughput resource preset. Explicit properties always win.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.runtime.io-workers
properties.description: Number of Tokio I/O workers shared by native Dubbo consumers.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.runtime.callback-workers
properties.description: Number of bounded native-to-Java completion callback workers.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.runtime.callback-queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum queued native-to-Java async completion callbacks.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.runtime.thread-stack-bytes
properties.description: Stack size of native Dubbo runtime and callback threads.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.consumer.providers
properties.description: Comma-separated static provider host:port endpoints. Kubernetes Service DNS is supported.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.consumer.connections-per-endpoint
properties.description: Bounded persistent TCP connections opened for each provider endpoint.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.consumer.command-queue-capacity
properties.description: Bounded command queue capacity per native connection.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.consumer.max-in-flight
properties.description: Maximum concurrent outstanding calls per generated consumer client.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.consumer.heartbeat-interval-ms
properties.description: Idle connection heartbeat interval. Set zero only when an external network policy owns idle connection liveness.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.consumer.timeout-ms
properties.description: End-to-end native RPC timeout used by generated clients.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.consumer.max-payload-bytes
properties.description: Hard upper bound for a consumer request or response payload.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.consumer.max-collection-items
properties.description: Decode safety bound for generated arrays, lists, and maps.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.consumer.initial-buffer-bytes
properties.description: Initial direct Hessian request buffer capacity per active Java caller.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.consumer.retained-buffers
properties.description: Maximum number of reusable request buffers retained globally. Set zero for the smallest idle footprint.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.consumer.max-retained-buffer-bytes
properties.description: Largest request buffer eligible for retention after a call.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.consumer.startup-check
properties.description: Fails application startup when references with check=true cannot reach a provider.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.consumer.startup-timeout-ms
properties.description: Maximum startup wait for references with check=true.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.provider.enabled
properties.description: Starts the native Dubbo provider listener for generated @DubboService dispatchers.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.provider.port
properties.description: Native Dubbo provider TCP listen port.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.provider.io-workers
properties.description: Dedicated Tokio I/O workers for the provider listener. This runtime is separate from Rust Hyper.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.provider.business-workers
properties.description: Bounded native workers allowed to enter generated Java provider dispatchers.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.provider.queue-capacity
properties.description: Bounded provider business queue. Full queues fail fast instead of growing memory without limit.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.provider.max-payload-bytes
properties.description: Hard upper bound for a provider request or response payload.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.provider.request-timeout-ms
properties.description: Maximum time allowed for provider dispatch and async completion.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.provider.drain-timeout-ms
properties.description: Graceful shutdown wait for in-flight provider requests.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.provider.default-max-concurrent
properties.description: Default concurrent execution limit for provider methods without an annotation or named-lane override.

properties.name: reactor.dubbo.provider.executors
properties.description: Named provider concurrency lanes referenced by @DubboService(executor=...).

values.description: Smallest default thread, queue, and retention surface.
Moderate concurrency with bounded memory growth.
Higher concurrency and retention for measured high-load services.
